Devices All devices on the fire alarm system shall be compatible with Apollo XP95 protocol. Tender Document r5d_V4.8_ENE_GenC4.8 (Supply) Photoelectric Smoke Detectors The primary fire detection on the system shall be by means of analogue addressable photoelectric type smoke detectors. Devices shall be fitted onto an addressable base. Detectors are to be easily replaceable without tools, and, when mounted at height, allow testing and replacement using an extension tool. Heat Detectors Heat detectors shall be of the rate of rise type or combination type (Heat / Smoke) They shall use the same base as the smoke detectors. Indoor / Outdoor Manual Call Points These shall be of the indoor flush or surface type. The units shall have the following characteristics: Device Type: Manual Call Point supplied with plastic cover Operating Principle: Breaking of glass causes switch to change state Sampling Frequency: Continuous Alarm Indicator: Red light emitting diode IP Rating (minimum): IPx4 Indoor IP66 Outdoor All call points shall use a non—frangible element which is resettable using a special key.

Con este documento, los licitadores ya no tendrán que proporcionar pruebas documentales completas y diferentes formularios utilizados anteriormente en la contratación pública de la UE , lo que significa una considerable simplificación del acceso a las oportunidades de licitación transfronterizas. La Comisión Europea proporciona un servicio gratuito en línea para los compradores, los licitadores y las demás partes interesadas en cumplimentar el documento de forma electrónica. El documento europeo único de contratación se ofrecerá exclusivamente en formato electrónico . El formulario en línea puede rellenarse, imprimirse y luego

d Substances (PFAS) Contamination Description: The 2020 National Defense Authoriza tion Act (NDAA) directed that Aqueous Film Forming Foams (AFFF) fire suppressants, due to the dangers the material poses to the environment and human health, must be replaced by a safer, more environmentally benign fire suppressant by October 1, 2024. DLA’s research in this area shall focus on flake graphite foam fo rmulation, qualifying the standards as defined in the military specifications, and testing of gra phite-one sourced foam that can extinguish Class B fires. This work funded by FY23 Congressionally Directed Funds (CDF) will aim to meet the mandated replacement of AFFF fire suppressants per the 2020 NDAA due to the hazards that PFAS contamination poses to the environment. Tender Document r5d_V4.8_ENE_GenC4.8 (Supply) Photoelectric Smoke Detectors The primary fire detection on the system shall be by means of analogue addressable photoelectric type smoke detectors. Heat Detectors Heat detectors shall be of the rate of rise type or combination type (Heat / Smoke) They shall use the same base as the smoke detectors. Indoor / Outdoor Manual Call Points These shall be of the indoor flush or surface type. Introduction/Background This Statement of Work (SOW) outlines the requirements for the depot-level maintenance and repair of the NATO Seasparrow system components listed in Section 6. The objective of this SOW is to ensure the reliable and cost-effective repair of these components to CODE A condition, ready for issue, in accordance with the references located in Section 2. The work described herein is critical to maintaining the operational readiness and availability of the NATO Seasparrow system. 1.0 Scope The scope of this SOW encompasses all actions required to perform depot-level repair on the electronic components listed in Section 6. This includes, but is not limited to, receiving inspection, disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair, replacement of parts, reassembly, testing, marking, and packaging according to the applicable Technical Repair Standard (TRS). In the absence of a TRS, the contractor may conduct the repair in accordance with locally generated procedures. In the case locally generated procedures are used, Final Acceptance Testing will be accomplished in accordance with the ap

m the BER DLR. 4.2.4 Quality Assurance and Record of Repair/TIDRR Quality Assurance checks shall be performed at all inspection hold points called out in the TRS by qualified quality assurance inspectors according to the TRS. In the absence of a TRS where the DLR is being serviced according to a locally generated procedure, The Contractor will, at a minimum, conduct a final inspection to verify proper reassembly, operation, finish, and required markings. When the DLR is packaged and ready for shipment, the Contractor will also conduct an inspection to assure proper packaging. Upon completion of repair and restoration of the DLR, the Traveler and Inspection/Discrepancy/Repair Report (TIDRR) shall serve as the official record of all examinations and tests conducted on the DLR. All discrepancies, recommended and corrective actions, test results, repair actions, as well as the data from examinations and inspections shall be recorded on a working copy of the TIDRR. It shall also verify the work performed during restoration/repair and remain with the DLR at all times. When completed, a copy of the TIDRR shall be retained by the overhaul and repair activity for review by the cognizant engineering agent and as a data source for repairables management program information requir
